test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

The dedicated teacher laboured __assiduously__ to aid her pupils in achieving success.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"assiduously" **means** showing great care and perseverance.**
 
• The word** "committed" **is a suitable synonym for **"assiduously"** in this context, as it conveys dedication and hard work.
 
• The other options **do not convey** the same level of dedication and effort required to aid pupils in achieving success.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *The dedicated teacher laboured **committedly** to aid her pupils in achieving success.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: "un-biased" - This word means impartial, which does not fit the context of showing dedication.
 
• Option 3: "uninvolved" - This word means not taking part, which is the opposite of showing dedication.
 
• Option 4: "apathetic" - This word means showing no interest or enthusiasm, which is contrary to the meaning of **"assiduously".**
